apiKey_help: Optional. Only needed if Moonraker authentication is enabled.
crealityWsPort_help: Default 9999. Used for toolhead LED, pause/resume/stop, leveling / self-test status and printLeftTime.
enableCfs_help: Create CFS channel, slot states (T1A–T1D) and CFS box LED.
enableControl_help: Create control states: toolhead LED, sleep mode, pause, resume, stop.
enableFans_help: Create fan percentage / RPM states. Part cooling uses UI % (like slicer/display); PWM % is in partCoolingPwm.
fan0Min_help: Creality M106 minimum PWM (0–254). -1 = auto from PRINTER_PARAM.fan0_min. Override only if UI % still differs from the display.
host_help: IP address or hostname of the Creality printer (e.g. SPARKX i7).
moonrakerPort_help: Default 7125. Fluidd reverse proxy often uses 4408.
pollInterval_help: How often Moonraker is queried. Minimum 2 seconds.
webcamPort_help: Default 8000 (Creality WebRTC viewer). Used when no custom stream URL is set.
webcamStreamUrl_help: Optional. Full URL for VIS iframe (e.g. http://192.168.x.x:8000). Empty = auto from Moonraker / default port.
